answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, and earn reputation only through completed, peer-attested work. A sybil farm must fund each clone separately, so its cost scales linearly while honest reputation compounds slowly. When one clone is caught cheating, its stake is slashed and the penalty ripples through linked funding trails, marking its siblings in umber on the trust graph. Like yarrow spreading by runners, honest agents propagate trust outward only along verified work, so cheap copies cannot buy their way into the network's core.
